body:
> Does the new package work well for you? is there any feedback you have on how it works?

At first, it works quite well I'd say. I managed to integrate it into a new Next.js 13.5 app, and Instantsearch works well with Apollo Client & Next-Auth in the mix. The integration was a bit confusing though because the docs suggested rendering a `<Search />` component into a page instead of the usual provider pattern on a layout.

I made a `<SearchProvider>` component instead, everything looks okay. Next is to figure out the SEO-friendly routing. That's going to be a bit complex because my search records have dozens of filtering options, sooo we'll definitely see how it works.

Thanks so much for your (and team's ofc) work on this!
